description: Header file defining the CrashReportSender class for uploading crash reports via HTTP(S) in Windows environment, including enums, class methods, and internal state management.

classes.name: CrashReportSender
classes.description: Class providing API to send crash reports, manage report limits, and handle checkpoint state.

methods.name: CrashReportSender
methods.description: Constructor initializing the crash report sender with optional checkpoint file.

methods.name: set_max_reports_per_day
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of crash reports to send per 24 hours.

methods.name: max_reports_per_day
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of reports allowed per day.

methods.name: SendCrashReport
methods.description: Sends crash report files and parameters to specified URL, returning result status.
